implementation: A fresh pnpm registry report is retained verbatim together with its real exit code. The package remains picomatch 4.0.7; no advisory is removed or relabeled in that original file.

The only local remediation classification matches GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf, picomatch, 4.0.7 findings, the known vulnerable range and high severity, after an in-process approved-content proof. All other high/critical findings remain unresolved blockers; unknown responses, counts, exits and proof failures fail closed.

Proof binds the reviewed LF patch SHA, pinned-pnpm lock patch hash, upstream SRI, workspace mapping, patched snapshots and every installed package file/directory. Bounded traversal covers ordinary pnpm copies, hoisted/root aliases and package-local nested shadow copies; every actual installed direct consumer must resolve one of the verified copies.

The shared Python declaration is parsed as strict JSON data by the JS helper, never executed. Saved proof/classification files are not trusted. Output paths are repository-relative; known report/lock/installation/content failures have safe distinct explanations.

Classification output is created exclusively and cannot overwrite an existing output or a hard link to the original raw audit. Security retains failed-job semantics and uploads both original and classified evidence.
